everything-claude-code.note: ECC plugin install attempted first, submodule as fallback

archify.note: Diagram skill (architecture/workflow/sequence/dataflow/lifecycle -> self-contained HTML). The repo-root archify/ directory is copied to ~/.claude/skills/archify; no `npx skills add` runs at install time.

codeburn.note: Local-first AI token/cost tracker; reads session files read-only, no proxy, no upload. Budget-guard hooks are opt-in (--with-codeburn-guard).

serena.note: Symbol-level code navigation/editing over MCP (stdio: `serena start-mcp-server --context claude-code --project-from-cwd`). Runs as an external MCP server; no Serena code is vendored into this repo.
serena.license_note: Per the upstream LICENSE: SolidLSP is MIT and the Serena application is GPL-3.0-or-later, and because the two are combined the distributed `serena-agent` package is as a whole subject to GPL-3.0-or-later. The MIT terms cover the SolidLSP files themselves if extracted separately. serena-agent's PyPI metadata declares MIT and is inaccurate — do not "correct" this entry back to MIT from PyPI. Installed as a standalone uv tool and reached over MCP; no Serena code is copied into this repo, so nothing here is a derivative work.

headroom.note: Tool-output compression over MCP (stdio: `headroom mcp serve`) exposing headroom_compress / headroom_retrieve / headroom_stats. Proxy mode (`headroom proxy` + ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) also works on a subscription login but is a documented manual opt-in, never started by install.sh: Claude Code cannot connect while the proxy is down.

ast-grep.note: Structural code search/rewrite CLI used by agents

andrej-karpathy-skills.note: Karpathy's LLM coding guidelines; install.sh [5d] curls CLAUDE.md at the pinned commit, checksum-verifies it against KARPATHY_EXPECTED_CHECKSUM, and appends it to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md. No code vendored into this repo.
